title: Timber´s Call
description: Timber’s Call adds Grimbark, an automatic woodcutting NPC, unique workstations for progression, mystical crafting, and a boss fight — all without a resource pack. Answer the call!
body:
**Timber’s Call** is an immersive Minecraft datapack that adds **Grimbark**, a loyal NPC who helps you farm wood automatically — and best of all, it works without needing any resource pack!

**Key Features:**

🧔 **Grimbark, your dedicated Woodcutting NPC:** Put your lumber chores on autopilot — Grimbark tirelessly fells trees and gathers logs for you!

⚒️ **4 Custom Workstations:** Unlock new tools and automation with uniquely modeled stations — essential for progressing through the datapack and upgrading your base.

🏹 **Epic Bossfight:** Challenge yourself in an intense battle required to advance your journey and unlock special rewards — but beware, this boss has more than one trick up its sleeve!

🔮 **Mystical Recipes:** Craft powerful and mystical items to aid you on your adventures.

Bring your world to the next level — **Timber’s Call** makes every forest deeper, every build richer, and every fight more thrilling. Will you answer the call?

**Get all items by command:**

```
/function timbers_call:items
```
